name: Citation
description: A small numbered marker, like [1], inside a reply that jumps to the source it refers to.

source.description: The source this marker points to.

href.description: Where the marker goes. Defaults to the matching entry in a Sources list on the same page.

keyboard: Enter: follows the link; with the default target, moves focus to the source entry
requirements: A real link, not a button: it goes somewhere
Its name says what it is ("Source 2: Title"), never just "2"
Focus moves to the source entry when it is on the same page, so Tab continues from there

use_when: Marking which statement came from which source
avoid_when: Footnotes that aren't sources: use plain footnotes
anti_patterns: Using only a number as the link name
Citations with no list of sources to jump to
